query:
SELECT
                c.chat_id AS "chat_id: _"
            FROM chat c
            INNER JOIN "group" g ON g.group_id = c.group_id
            LEFT JOIN blocked_contact b ON b.user_uuid = c.connection_user_uuid
                AND b.user_domain = c.connection_user_domain
            WHERE c.status != ?1
                AND b.user_uuid IS NULL
